environment: Headless Chrome, SwiftShader software GPU, offline Battleon vector fixture at 900x515. No authentication or server connection.
workload: Paused scene with one child removed and replaced on each of three profiled frames. Initial allocation excluded, scenery caching disabled, partial uploads enabled in both modes. A final full-frame pixel comparison checks grouped against ungrouped rendering.
limits: CPU timings include submission and driver waits, not completed GPU time. This is not a gameplay FPS benchmark. Render groups can introduce minor floating-point/antialiasing differences.
